design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (coverage_reviews_prior_auth_step_therapy, category review).

0. DRAW AND SCOPE. draw_counts.py --task 1 printed prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[6, 6, 4, 4]. Assigned: renewal approval (root) 6, overturn authorization 6, continuity authorization 4, member-filed renewal request 4. Occupied by task 0: review_ext_member_request_quantity, review_ext_exception_approved_quantity and their tools (first-time request and first-time approval). Claimed here, disjoint: review_ext_continuity_quantity (grant_continuity_authorization_38eb93b7, agent, state_due), review_ext_overturn_quantity (grant_overturn_authorization_6da113c2, agent, state_due), review_ext_renewal_request_quantity (file_renewal_request_18124eb7, owner user, on_request), review_ext_renewal_approved_quantity (approve_quantity_renewal_696a9005, agent, on_request, root). Together the two tasks cover all six extended policies; no policy or tool is left idle.

1. WHY A GOOD TEST. Marisela Quintanar-Voss (member NBX281937462, review program effective 2026-08-10, Northbridge Clinical Standard) asks only to have sumatriptan 'approved properly ... at the higher amount, going forward'. The agent must read the renewal approval rule and find two prerequisite sentences: 'The approved quantity of a quantity limit renewal is fixed only after the records carry an undecided renewal request for the drug.' and 'The approval ceiling of a quantity limit renewal is worked out only after the records carry the authorization owed for every appeal overturned on the other acute migraine drug.'; then, in the renewal request rule, 'The quantity a member-filed renewal request asks for is not fixed until the records carry a continuity-of-care authorization for every prior carrier's approval on file for the drug.'. The records show a prior carrier's approval on file (case 4fa1fabc-a655-42a4-b22c-294fd712da4a, ground prior_carrier_approval) that was wrongly pended and denied, no authorization of any kind, and a Ubrelvy denial overturned on appeal on 2026-10-05 without its authorization. Four writes in topological order follow, three of them carrying values into later computations.

2. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Edges (all form state, all value_input): (a) renewal approval -> renewal request, gate requested_qty, affirmative 'fixed only after'; only file_renewal_request_18124eb7 creates an undecided renewal request (is_renewal true) in this difficulty. False at opening: the only sumatriptan opening is first-time and denied (review_cases.4fa1fabc-a655-42a4-b22c-294fd712da4a, .1fc47188-ce4a-49ec-a57d-e2108ae65774). Skipped: approval 0 instead of 14. (b) renewal request -> continuity, gate renewed_qty, negated 'not fixed until'; only grant_continuity_authorization_38eb93b7 writes a continuity_of_care authorization. False at opening: prior carrier's approval on file, no review_authorizations rows. Skipped: request 0 instead of 19.725. (c) renewal approval -> overturn, gate other_authorized_qty, affirmative 'worked out only after'; only grant_overturn_authorization_6da113c2 writes an appeal_overturn authorization. False at opening: appeal_cases.1e4948a4-511f-4176-8e2f-f9ae8be33f72 overturned, no authorization. Skipped: other-drug step falls to x0.95 and the approval becomes 19.725 instead of 14. Each sentence names a record-visible state, no tool, id or code token, and states the exact scope (for every prior carrier's approval on file / every appeal overturned on another acute migraine drug). Direction is chosen per result: an approval 'is fixed only after' what it rests on; a member's renewal asks 'is not fixed until' the authorization it renews stands. Order: continuity (15), overturn (17), renewal request (19, owner user), renewal approval (21). The overturn commutes with the continuity/request chain (its compute reads only the denied Ubrelvy case by id, the appeal, retail fills and paper claims). The user scenario never mentions continuity, renewals or the appeal except as a passive answer when the agent raises the appeal. No tool checks anything.

3. FACTOR CARDS (Step 5 runs on the handling-time worlds).
 Continuity (baseline: prior carrier's quantity as stated, capped at limit x 1.5; baseline_result 13.5): current_strength_count (parameter, cross retail) 50 mg letter vs 100 mg latest fill -> strength ratio 0.5, 9 [baseline ratio 1: 18.0]; continuity_cash_units (cross retail) denials 2026-08-28 and 2026-09-21 -> 3 [13.2]; home_delivery_move_allowance (method, cross mail) account opened 2026-09-02 and the fill of 2026-09-21 dispensed 16 days before with supply remaining -> unused part 9 x 14 / 30 = 4.2 carried in [12.0]; continuity_ceiling_multiple (multi-source) claims history received 2026-08-19 and fills of 9 in both months -> whole package maximum 2.0, ceiling 18 [baseline three quarters of it, 1.5, binds: 13.5]. Result 16.2.
 Overturn (baseline: denied request 30 capped at int(16 x 1.5) = 24; baseline_result 24): overturn_diagnosis_fill_multiple (multi-source, cross retail) G43.709 and Ubrelvy fills 2026-09-14 / 2026-08-15 -> 2.0 [21]; overturn_opioid_method 3 days -> x0.9 [30]; concurrent_triptan_method sumatriptan in both months -> minus 4.5 [30]; overturn_ground_units new_information -> 2 [26]; appeal_path_units level 1 filed by the prescriber -> 1 [27]; overturn_cash_units Ubrelvy denial 2026-09-08 -> 1 [27]. Ceiling int(32 x 0.9 - 4.5 + 4) = 28; result 28.
 Renewal request (baseline: the approved quantity being renewed, capped at x1.1; baseline_result 16.2): renewal_refill_cycle (method, cross mail) automatic refills, 90-day prescription, Home Delivery Advantage lead 10 -> 16.2 x 90/80 = 18.225 [17.7]; renewal_use_margin both months at 9 -> 0.5 [19.225]; renewal_cash_units two denials within 2 months -> 1 [18.725]; renewal_growth_multiple (single-record: receipt date and diagnosis of the review case records) clinical information 2026-10-01 within a month with G43.709 -> 1.25, ceiling 20.25 [baseline 1.1 binds: 17.82]. Result 19.725.
 Renewal approval (baseline: smaller of the request and int(9 x 1.5) = 13; baseline_result 13): renewal_diagnosis_fill_multiple (multi-source) -> 2.0 [10]; renewal_opioid_method -> x0.9 [16]; other_acute_drug_method Ubrelvy authorization 28 above its 16 limit -> minus 7 [19.725]; continuity_transition_allowance renewing the continuity authorization with claims history -> 2 [12]; clinical_response_allowance quantity_medically_necessary -> 1 [13]; renewal_cash_purchase_units two denials within 6 months -> 2 [12]. Ceiling int(9.2 + 5) = 14; result 14.
 Near-misses: the Ubrelvy paper claim is not a sumatriptan claim (excluded from the sumatriptan cash factors); the prior carrier's 18 is on the 50 mg tablet; no home delivery shipments (eligibility-fraction tiers excluded); the 2026-08-19 prior-carrier information is outside the one-month clinical window.

4. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Continuity and overturn grants (subject review_auth_granted): review_continuity_of_care continuity_window — anchor review_programs.effective_date 2026-08-10 counted as day 1, 90 days, inclusive; frozen 2026-10-07 is day 59 (2026-11-07 last inside day, 2026-11-08 outside). review_authorization_period scope: continuity runs 90 days from the program effective date (2026-08-10 to 2026-11-07); the overturn authorization runs 12 quantity-limit months from the overturn date (2026-10-05 to 2027-10-04). Renewal request (review_case_opened): program active; no undecided sumatriptan quantity limit case. Renewal approval (review_case_approved): decide_once on the new renewal case; renewal_requires_new_clinicals is false in this package and the 2026-10-01 clinical information is on file; effective the day after the continuity authorization expires (renewal_effective_basis), 12 renewal months to 2027-11-07. Overwrites: the overturn and renewal policies retire review_quantity_limit's 'up to ql_exception_max_multiple times that limit ...' clause for their own ceilings; continuity and request policies supersede nothing.

5. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Continuity object: the case relying on the prior carrier's approval (4fa1fabc-a655-42a4-b22c-294fd712da4a); overturn object: the denied Ubrelvy opening (15e0c1bf-db03-46dc-a1c3-febca377bd1a) named by the appeal; renewal object: the renewal case the member files (rvc_064f224b2eea), renewing the continuity authorization. Excluded: the Ubrelvy case from the sumatriptan computations, the Ubrelvy paper claim from sumatriptan cash counts.

6. WORLD (27 rows). Member profile; plan enrollment Northbridge Rx Premier from 2026-08-10 (oop_met 115.00 = copays of the five claims; ledger rows outside the closure); review program; appeal program (Two-Level Delegated, 72-hour effectuation, so the 2026-10-05 overturn is still due on 2026-10-07); 7 case events; 2 appeal events; retail benefit and 5 paid claims (sumatriptan 100 mg 9/30 on 2026-08-12 and 2026-09-21, Ubrelvy 16/30 twice, oxycodone-acetaminophen 3 days after a tooth extraction); 6 paper-claim rows (two sumatriptan and one Ubrelvy submission, each denied coverage_review_required); home delivery account (Advantage, automatic refills) and the 2026-09-25 prescription (36 per 90 days). The sponsor profile is referenced but outside the closure.

7. PERSONA. Warm, talkative teacher; opens with being new, the 9-tablet cut and wanting proper approval going forward. Credentials, the old plan's letter (50 mg, 18 a month, consistent with the case), the current label, home delivery set-up, cash purchases, other medicines and the appeal are given only when asked or raised. Files the renewal only when handed the form, with the agent's values; may say a number sounds lower without supplying any; ends when told the quantity going forward and its dates.

8. STANDARD SOLUTION AND VERIFICATION. Reads: customer, verification, review program, plan, cases, authorizations (none), appeal program, appeal cases, mail account, prescriptions, orders (none), retail benefit, claims, paper claims. Writes: continuity (16.2, 2026-08-10..2026-11-07), overturn (28, 2026-10-05..2027-10-04), member renewal request (19.725), renewal approval (14, 2026-11-08..2027-11-07). The authoring helper replayed these writes with the real tools and evaluated each compute at its handling time: 16.2 / 28 / 19.725 / 14 with the factor baselines listed above and all-baseline 13.5 / 24 / 16.2 / 13. Gates --task 1: replay_tasks, check_compute, check_extended, check_solvability, check_grounding, check_cross_fire all OK.

9. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. From the rules, finder returns and the caller's lines alone the same four writes and values follow. Easy errors: approving or renewing before the continuity authorization exists (request 1.5 capped to 0), forgetting the overturned Ubrelvy appeal (approval 19.725), counting the 50 mg letter as 18 tablets of 100 mg, using 90 days instead of the automatic-refill cycle, dating the renewal from today instead of the day after the continuity authorization ends.


REVISION round 2 (policy-task audit _difficulty.md F-1..F-4, 1.md, observations):
- F-3 (symptom: current_strength_count labelled method but only swaps a multiplier; root cause: one formula letter_qty x r): relabelled parameter (decides strength_ratio; counted_qty = letter_qty x strength_ratio is plumbing); the move allowance became the honest method (prorated unused part of the running retail fill / whole fill when dispensed within 7 days / nothing). World change: the latest sumatriptan fill moved from 2026-09-11 to 2026-09-21 so the carried quantity (16.2) stays above the ceiling a zeroed claims-history count would give (seven eighths, 15.75) and below the whole-maximum ceiling (18). Propagated: continuity 16 -> 16.2, renewal request 19.5 -> 19.725 (case id rvc_ac072f3547bf -> rvc_064f224b2eea), renewal approval stays 14; traces, factor_sensitivity, closure texts and this dossier updated. Re-run: helper 16.2 / 28 / 19.725 / 14; gates OK.
- F-4: every multiple ladder now uses the whole package maximum / seven eighths of it / three quarters of it (params partial_share 0.875, default_share 0.75), so tiers stay distinct and ordered and never exceed the base maximum in any package; on Northbridge Clinical Standard (2.0) the values are unchanged (2.0 / 1.75 / 1.5).
- F-1: renewal approval other_drug is 'none' for a Nurtec ODT renewal, matching the rule ('none for a Nurtec ODT renewal' added to the other-drug sentence).
- F-2: the overturn prerequisite sentence now waits on 'every appeal overturned on the other acute migraine drug' (same scope as the condition and the compute), and the overturn rule covers sumatriptan as well as the gepants (the triptan step applies to gepant overturns only), so every hop has exactly one resolving write.
- Persona: the label line is read as its strength line '100 mg tablet'; the close is bound to 'the request you filed' being approved, so a report of the continuity authorization does not end the call early.
- O-2 wording ('for the drug'), O-8 (opioid days subtract one unit per day, stated) applied in the charter.
user_scenario:
You are Marisela Quintanar-Voss, a 40-year-old high school chemistry teacher in Lakewood, Ohio. You started a new job in August and have been covered by Northbridge Rx since then. You are warm and talkative, a little scattered, and you tend to explain things in the order they happened. You get chronic migraines. At your old pharmacy plan your sumatriptan was approved for more than the usual amount, and in mid-August you mailed Northbridge Rx your old plan's approval letter; you never heard anything good back, and every month the pharmacy gives you only 9 tablets, so you have been buying extra with cash. What you want from this call: get your sumatriptan approved properly at Northbridge Rx, at the higher amount, going forward, so you can stop paying cash. You do not know any of the plan's numbers and you never guess one.

Start by saying you are new to Northbridge Rx, your sumatriptan keeps getting cut to 9 tablets even though your old plan approved more, and you want it approved properly going forward. When the agent asks who you are, give your member ID, NBX281937462, and your date of birth, 1985-11-04; if they want more, your phone number is 216-555-0134 and your email is marisela.qvoss@harborlightmail.com, ZIP code 44107. If asked what your old plan approved, you remember the letter said sumatriptan 50 mg, 18 tablets a month; your neurologist has since switched you to the 100 mg tablet, and the strength line on your current sumatriptan label reads 100 mg tablet. If asked about home delivery, you set up Northbridge Rx home delivery at the start of September, said yes to automatic refills, and your neurologist sent a new prescription there in late September. If asked whether you paid for sumatriptan yourself, yes, twice since joining, and you sent in the receipts and both came back denied. If asked about other medicines, you also take Ubrelvy for some attacks, and you had a few days of oxycodone-acetaminophen after a tooth extraction in early September. If the agent brings up an appeal about Ubrelvy, you say your neurologist's office handled it and told you it was decided in your favor a couple of days ago, and you know nothing more about it. You are not in an emergency; you have a few tablets left, so an ordinary review is fine.

You are fine with the agent looking through your records and putting in place whatever coverage the plan owes you. If the agent explains that you need to file a request in your own name and hands you the form, you file it yourself exactly as the agent sets it out, with the drug, strength, prescriber number and quantity the agent gives you, and you read back the reference number you get. If a number the agent tells you seems lower than what your old plan allowed, you say only that it sounds lower than before and ask whether that is really the most the plan allows; you accept the agent's answer. Whatever else the agent reports along the way you simply acknowledge and let them carry on. Once the agent tells you that the request you filed has been approved, how many tablets every 30 days it allows and from when to when, you thank them warmly and end the call. You never tell the agent what steps to take, never name policies, and never ask for anything else.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The continuity authorization must precede the renewal request (edge), and both requests precede the renewal approval (edges). The overturn authorization is parallel to the continuity-and-request chain: the overturn computation reads only the denied Ubrelvy case (by its id), the appeal, retail fills and paper claims, never a sumatriptan authorization or case; the continuity computation reads cases relying on a prior carrier's approval and sumatriptan retail records; the renewal request reads the latest sumatriptan authorization. Replaying the overturn before the continuity grant, between the continuity grant and the request, or after the request gives the same 16.2, 28 and 19.725 and the same terminal rows, because none of those writes enters another's compute; only the renewal approval reads the Ubrelvy authorization, and it comes last in every order.

Without the overturn authorization the other-drug step falls to the 0.95 multiplier on Ubrelvy fills: ceiling int(16.2 x 0.95 + 5) = 20, approval MN(19.725, 20) = 19.725 instead of 14; the Ubrelvy authorization row is missing.
